title: 第15章 灾祸提前第16章 种子入丹田
slug: 重生后长公主只想种田
content_zh:
;;
转动轮椅过去，想要把沈青鱼扶起。
忽然听到‘咔嚓’一声，正要开口时发现沈青鱼正眼神直勾勾地盯着他的轮椅下面看，他下意识也低头去看。
余光瞧见，沈青鱼的手也伸到了一半，这会正停在半空。
看了看她的手，又看了看轮椅下碎了的黑玉盒子。
“好你个老冰棍！我都没嫌你老牛吃嫩草，你竟然吃干抹净了还要毁我钱财。”
沈青鱼推开轮椅，手哆嗦着去捡黑玉盒。
“这都碎得捡不起来了，你个败家老爷们。”
黑玉盒子是没救了，沈青鱼扒拉开碎玉，想要把里面不知是种子还是石头的东西捡起来。
这时轮椅又动了下，刚露出来的东西又被碾了下。
咔！
沈青鱼：……
云珏（⊙o⊙）…
众人齐刷刷朝轮椅后面看去，吓得小桃连忙摆手，眼泪说来就来。
“对，对不起，奴婢不是故意的。”小桃脸色煞白，眼泪一个劲往下掉，突然指着小梨说道，“是，是小梨推的奴婢。”
小梨看了看自己的手，然后摊开给沈青鱼看。
刚整了木炭，想要烤妖肉来着，两只手都是黑色的。
真要推了人，被推的那个衣服肯定有黑印子。
“给脸不要脸，杀了吧。”沈青鱼道。
看在从小一起长大的份上，给了她一条活路，可给脸不要脸，那干脆就不要活了。

小桃面色大变，转身就想跑。
蓝影与红焰一左一右，很快就把她抓住带了回来。
“殿下，奴婢知道错了，求你放过奴婢。”小桃满眼恐惧。
沈青鱼是重生过来了，记忆却在漫长的岁月长河里遗忘了许多。
记忆里有关小桃的不多，只知道是自己从小当亲姐妹一起长大的。喜欢上了她的驸马爷，因此背叛了她。
到底是一起长大，蓝影几个都有些不忍，下不了这个手。
看向沈青鱼的眼神，欲言又止。
“想求情？”
沈青鱼把轮椅推开，将‘小石头’捡起来看了看，发现还真的是裂开了，顿时皱起眉头。
这应该是颗种子，都裂了，不知还有用没。
此时的她并没有注意到，刚摔那一下手破了皮，鲜血顺着种子裂开的缝隙流进去，散发出一道光芒，转瞬消失。
“我懂你们意思，可以再给她一次机会。”看在从小一起长大的情分上，沈青鱼也不想为了一个小桃，让他们三个太过心寒。
“不过她不能留在府上了，送走吧，按上次说的，送周荣那里去。”
小梨补充了句：“小心点，别让人截胡了。”
红焰面无表情，上次是他送出去的，人也是在他手上被截胡的。
这一次，他定要完成任务。
沈青铉气冲冲出了长公主府，越想就越是来气，思来想去不知该如何是好，干脆就进了宫。

He turned the wheelchair and tried to lift Shen Qingyu up.
Suddenly he heard a 'click', and when he was about to speak, he found that Shen Qingyu was staring directly under his wheelchair, and he subconsciously lowered his head to look.
From the corner of his eye, he saw that Shen Qingyu's hand had reached halfway and was now stopping in mid-air.
He looked at her hands and then at the broken black jade box under the wheelchair.
"Well, you old popsicle! I don't even mind that you, an old cow, eat young grass, but you actually eat it up and destroy my money."
Shen Qingyu pushed away the wheelchair and picked up the black jade box with trembling hands.
"This is too broken to be picked up, you prodigal man."
The black jade box was hopeless. Shen Qingyu pulled apart the broken jade, trying to pick up the seeds or stones inside.
At this time, the wheelchair moved again, and the newly exposed items were crushed again.
Click!
Shen Qingyu:......
Yun Jue (⊙o⊙)…
Everyone looked behind the wheelchair. Xiao Tao was so frightened that she waved her hands quickly, tears coming as soon as she asked.
"Yes, I'm sorry, I didn't mean it." Xiao Tao's face turned pale, tears kept falling, and she suddenly pointed at Xiaoli and said, "Yes, it's the slave Xiaoli pushed."
Xiaoli looked at her hands, then spread them out for Shen Qingyu to see.
I had just adjusted the charcoal and wanted to grill demon meat, but my hands were all black.
If someone was really pushed, the person being pushed would definitely have black marks on his clothes.
"You have no shame, just kill him." Shen Qingyu said.
For the sake of growing up together, she was given a way to live, but if she was shameless, she might as well not live.
Xiaotao's expression changed drastically, she turned around and wanted to run away.
Lan Ying and Hong Yan, one on the left and the other on the right, quickly caught her and brought her back.
"Your Highness, I know I was wrong. Please let me go." Xiao Tao's eyes were full of fear.
Shen Qingyu was reborn, but his memories were forgotten in the long river of time.
I don’t remember much about Xiaotao, I only know that I grew up as a sister. He fell in love with her consort, so he betrayed her.
After all, they grew up together, so Lan Ying and the others couldn't bear it and couldn't do this.
Looking at Shen Qingyu, he hesitated to speak.
"Want to beg for mercy?"
Shen Qingyu pushed the wheelchair away, picked up the 'little stone' and looked at it. He found that it was really cracked and frowned immediately.
This should be a seed. It's all cracked. I don't know if it's still useful.
At this time, she didn't notice that the skin on her hand was broken when she dropped it, and the blood flowed in along the crack of the seed, emitting a ray of light and disappearing in an instant.
"I understand what you mean, I can give her another chance." Considering the friendship they had grown up with since childhood, Shen Qingyu didn't want to make the three of them too disappointed just because of a little peach.
"But she can't stay at home. Let's send her away. As I said last time, send her to Zhou Rong."
Xiaoli added: "Be careful, don't let anyone cut off your hair."
Hongyan's face was expressionless. He was the one who sent it out last time, and the person's beard was also cut off in his hands.
This time, he must complete the task.
Shen Qingxuan rushed out of the eldest princess's mansion angrily. The more he thought about it, the angrier he became. After much thought, he didn't know what to do, so he simply entered the palace.
